name: Model Architecture Training Sidecar
description: A non-destructive training-semantics overlay for the canonical model-architecture-3d-deck right view, with forward hidden state, backward activation gradients, parameter/optimizer state, metric strips, selectable Layer focus lenses, and click-through annotation inspectors.

source.visualContract: The canonical side view remains owned by model-architecture-3d-deck. This pattern reads projected DOM bounds and adds sibling SVG/DOM overlays without redefining base nodes, colors, residual rails, FFN bands, or projection math. In the collapsed right view, each Decoder Layer owns one narrow full-model-height hit strip in a dedicated SVG interaction layer above operator annotations; clicking anywhere on that vertical strip selects the Layer, while operator details become clickable only inside the expanded Layer. A selected Layer may request a temporary symmetric depth gap through the base renderer's public setLayerExpansion API; the selected Layer remains at its canonical coordinate, surrounding Layers move apart, and collapsing restores the exact default geometry. The expanded Layer renders its real openPangu operator rows vertically at their projected Y positions. Operator names are the only row labels: do not add redundant NORM, PROJECTION, ROUTING, ADD, or other operator-type pills. Core mock telemetry is printed directly on every operator row, while click details retain definitions, full values, status assessment, and execution context. Attention and MLP/MoE residual identity paths remain visible as compact, high-contrast side rails. True Residual Add rows use a circular plus marker and stronger value contrast so the addition semantics do not rely on a faint color treatment; generic Merge rows are not marked as addition. In the sidecar preview, the base right-edge operator legend is disabled through its public showSideLabels option and replaced by projected per-row bands whose labels sit at the center of the operator extent. Input and output operators use the same projected-band labeling, and every sidecar annotation exposes a hover tip without forcing continuous canvas redraw. In right-view PP mode, redundant in-model PP pills are hidden only within the sidecar because the full-width Stage labels above the topology axis are the canonical PP labels for this composition; full-height PP boundaries and Send/Recv annotations remain visible. The training sidecar uses an expandable tall canvas and a right-view-specific fit with reserved top and bottom semantic lanes; do not compress annotations merely to preserve a fixed screenshot height. Model depth is represented only by Layer numbers and faint vertical alignment guides; do not draw a horizontal topology axis, tick dots, or an arrowhead. Per-Layer Std σ, Amax, and latency are rendered as aligned small-multiple line charts with independent scales, units, reference bands, and interactive points. Forward and backward tensor-flow lanes use borderless, low-contrast directional chevrons generated from the current projected Layer-dot coordinates, with exactly one chevron centered between each adjacent pair of Layer dots. Side-view panning uses a drag fast path: apply only the current pan delta as a compositor transform to projected overlays while dragging and perform one full DOM/projection rebuild on pointer release. All projected annotation offsets, type, strokes, dots, chart points, textures, hit strips, expanded rows, and values share the base model zoom ratio.

mockDataRule: Every synthetic snapshot must include provenance=mock plus step, microbatch, rank, stage, layer, and tensor context. Softmax logits and probabilities must remain distinct; Weight/optimizer state belongs to an optimization step rather than one microbatch.
forbiddenOverrides: Do not edit or restyle model-architecture-3d-deck internals from this pattern.
Do not relabel the real L0-L45 Decoder stack as a generic 48-layer stack.
Do not draw parameter gradients as the backward inter-layer transport.
Do not present mock values as measured telemetry.
Do not replace source-validated openPangu operators with a generic Transformer stack.
agentReuseRule: Load model-graphviz, then model-architecture-3d-deck, then this sidecar. Call PtoModelArchitectureTrainingSidecar.render. Extend training data and the layer-detail slot without copying or changing the base deck renderer. Every added sidecar annotation must use the shared tip/detail metadata contract so it remains hoverable and opens the inspector; metrics must include a definition, current value, reference range, status assessment, and execution context.
